title: Dynamic Relational Transitioning Geometry (TRPG): code, data and documents
description: A relational, entanglement-based framework that reproduces known physics and predicts normal-ordered neutrino masses of 0.36, 8.7 and 50.1 to 50.3 meV (sum 0.0592 to 0.0594 eV), and a strong coupling of 0.1178 at the Z, awaiting measurement. This release contains every calculation script (all run with one command), the every-particle-to-every-particle workbook, the paper and the later test scripts. Website: https://trpgphysics.org
